problems.question: contradicts_spec
problems.issue: For year -1 the call `date::to_date_string(agent, tv)` returns "-000001" instead of the spec's "-0001". DateString (sec-datestring) requires the year to be ToZeroPaddedDecimalString(abs(yv), 4) with a '-' sign for negative years. The padding is wrong in the shared support::date helper (outside this diff, and outside the ticket's listed file), and the worker did not fix or report it. Test262 negative-year.js fails in both modes.
